cornerofeye.journal.arrival.0:
If you are reading this, it found you too.

I don't know how many nights I have left. I'll write down what I understand, when I understand it.
cornerofeye.journal.arrival.1:
It stands in the dark, right at the edge of your vision.

Turn to look and there is nothing there. You can only ever see it from the corner of your eye.
cornerofeye.journal.arrival.2:
It puts out the lights. Only the ones you aren't looking at. Torches, furnaces, lanterns, even glowstone.

Nothing it puts out comes back on by itself.
cornerofeye.journal.scraps.0: I went to where I had seen it standing. It didn't let me close. But there was something on the ground: a scrap, cold, like a torn piece of shadow.
cornerofeye.journal.scraps.1:
I think they matter. Collect them while it is still only watching.

Later it leaves almost nothing.
cornerofeye.journal.scraps.2:
The dog growled at an empty corner all night. In the morning there was a scrap lying there.

Animals know where it is. Look where they look.
cornerofeye.journal.lantern.0:
Light doesn't kill it. It shows it.

A lantern in the middle, a scrap on each side, amethyst in the corners. I made one. It hums.
cornerofeye.journal.flash.0:
Hold the lantern until it chimes, then let go.

If it is anywhere in sight at that moment, even at the very edge, it is caught.
cornerofeye.journal.flash.1:
Every flash burns a scrap. Don't waste them.

Once the hunt begins you have to be much closer to catch it.
cornerofeye.journal.moments.0:
It has started coming differently. Sometimes it shows itself. A clock starts ticking in your head and you just know what you have to do.

Do it.
cornerofeye.journal.moments.1:
Flint lights what it put out again, but never while it is still near.

Only fresh light saves you, and it has to be bright: stand right next to it.
cornerofeye.journal.moments.2:
A bell on a string: a gold ingot with iron nuggets around it. Keep it at hand. It rings when it is near.

Near the end it rang when nothing was there. I think.
cornerofeye.journal.moments.3:
Glass in an iron frame, on a stick. In a mirror you can look straight at it. Only at what is behind you.

Every time it is in there, the glass cracks.
cornerofeye.journal.moments.4:
Paper, gunpowder, redstone, coal: a flare. Throw it and it burns red for half a minute. That fire it cannot put out.

Don't make the doll. Wool, string and a scrap. I did. It is still here.
cornerofeye.journal.three.0:
It screams when you catch it.

Three times. Catch it three times and it leaves this world for good.
cornerofeye.journal.three.1:
The last time doesn't count just any night. Only under a blood moon.

That night it doesn't come alone. The others are empty. The dog only growls at the real one.
cornerofeye.journal.hunt.0:
The seventh night. It has stopped waiting. It comes through walls now.

If you don't have the lantern yet, find scraps while you still can.
cornerofeye.journal.hunt.1:
I caught it once.

It's in the corner now. I can see it.

Don't look at it.
